headline: US Proposes New Tariffs of 20% to 40% on 14 Trading Partners
summary: The US administration proposed maximum potential tariffs of 20% to 40% on 14 trading partners, including China, Japan, and the European Union, to counter excess industrial capacity.
why: Protectionist tariff proposals alter international trade flows, import cost structures, and corporate earnings for multinational exporters.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Proposed tariffs up to 40% threaten export volumes from targeted nations into the US market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The US administration announced proposed tariff rates ranging from 20% to 40% targeting excess industrial capacity in 14 trading partners.
